title: Farewell to gacha-style AI drawing! SenseTime open-sources SenseNova U1.6, first to endow an 8B model with native image self-correction capability
excerpt: In the field of AI image generation, developers and creators have long faced an unavoidable pain point: images generated by models often look stunning at first
content_html:
In the field of AI image generation, developers and creators have long faced an unavoidable pain point: images generated by models often look stunning at first glance but fall apart on closer inspection—especially when it comes to garbled text, broken layouts, illogical lighting and shadows, and other details. This has kept AI drawing stuck in a “blind box lottery” phase for a long time, making it difficult to use directly in commercial production.

Recently, SenseTime officially released and open-sourced SenseNova U1.6, a native multimodal model that directly targets this long-standing industry problem. The model continues the U series’ “unified understanding and generation” paradigm and, for the first time, introduces “native image self-correction” capability to an 8B-level open-source model, marking a shift in AI drawing from “one-way generation” to a new industrial stage of “closed-loop quality inspection.”

 Core Breakthrough: Teaching AI to “Find Its Own Flaws and Fix Them”
